title: Too much shrinkage!
text: Too much shrinkage!. The colors of this duvet are lovely and they are why I purchased it. However, after just one wash & drying (cold water/permanent press dryer setting) it shank so much I was dismayed.  I know cotton shrinks somewhat but this amount was ridiculous -- and the duvet looked ridiculous on my queen sized bed.

product_metadata.title: Madison Park Pure MPP12-019 Ronan 5 Piece Cotton Duvet Cover Set, Full/Queen (88 in x 92 in), Blue
features: Set includes: 1 duvet cover, 2 standard shams, 2 decorative pillows
Measurements: 88-by-92-inch duvet cover, 20-by-26-inch standard shams, 18-by-18-inch square pillow, 12-by-18-inch Oblong pillow
description: The Madison Park Pure Ronan Collection creates an organic look and feel to your space. The soft blue is the perfect base for this updated paisley design, while a solid blue reverse complements the top of the bed to create a restful oasis in your bedroom. Printed on 200 thread count cotton, this set includes a duvet cover, two shams and two decorative pillows.  A duvet cover is a protective cover for your comforter, most likely for your down comforter. Sometimes it’s referred to as a comforter cover. Duvet covers are not filled. It has an opening where you can insert your comforter. Filler not included.

details.Product Care Instructions: MACHINE WASH COLD, GENTLE CYCLE, AND SEPARATELY. DO NOT BLEACH. TUMBLE DRY LOW, REMOVE PROMPTLY, DO NOT IRON. IF THERE IS NO FREE MOVEMENT IN THE WASHER OR DRYER, USE LARGE CAPACITY COMMERCIAL WASHER/DRYER.
